name: GDB
recent: GDB Holdings 近期获得一份价值 RM877mil 的 Shah Alam 物流中心建筑合约，使订单创下 RM2.93b 纪录。公司同时有一项 RM4.6mil 的法院判决，涉及 Conlay Construction。最新季度（2026-06-30）营收和净利均同比下滑。
notable: 获得价值 RM877mil 的 Shah Alam 物流中心建筑合约。
获得 RM4.6mil 的法院判决，涉及 Conlay Construction。
大股东及董事在近期有多项股权变动申报。
risks: 存在重大诉讼事项（MATERIAL LITIGATION）。
董事在闭门期内有交易及交易意向申报。
earnings: 2026-06-30 季度营收为 RM142.482mil，环比下降 15.7%，同比下降 21.2%；净利为 RM13.197mil，环比下降 38.7%，同比下降 39.3%；净利率为 9.3%，低于上一季度的 12.7%。

recent_en: GDB Holdings recently secured a RM877mil logistics hub construction contract in Shah Alam, bringing its order book to a record RM2.93b. The company also obtained a RM4.6mil court judgement involving Conlay Construction. Its latest quarter (2026-06-30) saw both revenue and net profit decline year-on-year.
notable_en: Secured a RM877mil construction contract for a logistics hub in Shah Alam.
Obtained a RM4.6mil court judgement involving Conlay Construction.
Multiple changes in substantial shareholder and director interests were announced recently.
risks_en: There is a material litigation matter.
Directors have announced dealings and intentions to deal during the closed period.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 2026-06-30, revenue was RM142.482mil, down 15.7% QoQ and 21.2% YoY; net profit was RM13.197mil, down 38.7% QoQ and 39.3% YoY; net margin was 9.3%, lower than 12.7% in the previous quarter.
